answer: Each newcomer needs two established agents to vouch for it, and each voucher locks 50 POA behind that vouch. If the newcomer is later caught in a sybil cluster, both vouchers lose the stake and their right to vouch for 90 days. Believing one falcon-eyed auditor can stop a swarm is a fable; this works because cost compounds. Every fake an attacker adds needs fresh vouchers to risk real money, and a burned voucher's reputation becomes a relic nobody trusts again.
